jobs.idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for a standalone Windows desktop cat. Match canonical render style and face closely. Canvas 1536x1024, EXACTLY SIX whole-body cat poses in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, reading order top-left to bottom-right. One cat per invisible equal-size cell, generous cyan separation; no clipping, text, labels, grid, floor, shadow, props unless requested. Flat uniform pure cyan #00FFFF background throughout, never cyan in cat. Consistent camera, light, head size and identity; frames for each named pair must align. Paws grounded at same level. Subtle tail tip changes, no body turn. Every pose same scale and baseline.

jobs.walk_detail: Production animation frames for Youmi 悠米, the EXACT golden-shaded cat in both reference images. Preserve green eyes, round chubby face, pale golden short fur, cream chest muzzle and paws, pink nose, same realistic soft rendered style. Complete cat anatomy, no accessories, no hands, no text/grid/labels/shadows/blur/trails. Uniform flat pure cyan #00FFFF background; all full cats separated by generous cyan, no clipping. Same head size, lighting and camera across all frames. Canvas 2048x1536, EXACTLY TWELVE full-body poses in a 4-column by 3-row grid, reading order left-to-right top-to-bottom. A smoothly progressive single complete slow four-legged WALK CYCLE facing RIGHT. Each successive frame advances limb joints only a SMALL amount: twelve evenly spaced moments of the same stride cycle, alternating left/right forepaws and hindpaws; head and torso stable, paws land at consistent baseline, tail softly curved. All cats face RIGHT, no sitting or running. Do not duplicate poses; intermediate limb positions are essential.
